profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou that develops autonomous driving technology. Its own site describes it as a commercial-stage global company working on autonomous driving from Level 2 to Level 4, built around a universal platform it calls WeRide One, a self-developed foundational toolchain, and accumulated real-world operational data. The company says it offers five core products, including Robotaxi, and that its business footprint spans more than 60 cities across 13 countries.

WeRide is listed on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under 0800, and its SEC filings identify it as a for-profit corporation with CIK 0001867729. The company states that it has been recognized on Fortune's 2026 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists. No litigation, regulatory cases, or tracked product or MCP server records are associated with it in the material available here.
